label: Nothing gives what it lacks entails its cause-of-being restriction (inference)
rule: Restrict to causes of the effect's being; the causing hypothesis is unused
meaning: Strength order registration: the unrestricted principle (every cause of any perfection in a thing has it) entails its restriction to causes of the thing's being. Application only; it establishes neither. Strictness: control 15 (a cause of another perfection of a thing whose being it does not cause).
